title: Registered Nurse
canonicalBaseline: Career Profiles full snapshot lists Not started; re-read article/source/media rows before any remote write.
intro: Registered nurses (RNs) combine direct patient care with responsibility for understanding a patient’s needs, planning nursing care, and checking whether it is helping. They connect observations at the bedside with information from the wider healthcare team. Teaching a family how to manage care at home can be as important as using equipment or giving a treatment.
